materialSource.interpretation: Published values are finite-element model inputs, not subject-specific measurements or a direct tensile material test. The single-row-per-level reduction does not reproduce the source paper's 17 truss elements.

anatomicalAndFunctionalSources.use: Supports adjacent-spinous-process anatomy and level variability; its failure-force measurements were not substituted for stiffness.

anatomicalAndFunctionalSources.title: The resistance to flexion of the lumbar intervertebral joint
anatomicalAndFunctionalSources.use: Cadaver functional evidence that interspinous/supraspinous tissues contribute resistance near end-range flexion; used only as a directional plausibility check.

limits: Attachments are inferred posterior midline source-surface regional proxies, not measured individual entheses.
Area is an effective constitutive normalization carried from the FE input; no mass is added.
The modeled subset is L1-L5 interspinous only. It is not complete spinal ligament coverage.
All-185 triangle-intersection checks at reference and one 0.05-rad master flexion probe do not prove clearance through closed solids because the registered source meshes are open.
A short kinematic probe is not a native physics or physiologic qualification.
